_comment: MAINTAINER RECORD FOR THIS TEMPLATE — not something an adopter needs, and tools/init.sh
offers to delete it along with tools/check-upstream-drift.sh.
This template was extracted from a running system that keeps meeting incidents and keeps
writing down what it learned. Those lessons are the product. This file records how far
along that history the template has been brought, so 'did I miss anything?' is a command
(tools/check-upstream-drift.sh) rather than a judgement call over a hand-read git log.
Update last_synced_upstream_sha in the same pull request that carries a sync across.
A sync point nobody updates makes the tool report the same commits forever, until
somebody stops running it — which is worse than having no tool at all.

not_carried.why: A session-start hook kept a shallow clone of a vendor CLI and advanced it with a fast-forward pull, which cannot advance a --depth 1 clone; when the copy was ahead the fetch reported 'Already up to date' and the hook printed 'synced' while running stale code. No surface here: this template ships no session-start hook, its one shallow clone (tools/ledger.sh) is a fresh throwaway per run with no pull after it, and the CLI adapter bootstraps over npm.
